title: An equation as particles
caption: CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O: one methane molecule and two oxygen molecules become one carbon dioxide and two water molecules. Count the atoms: 1 C, 4 H and 4 O on each side, so mass is conserved.
alt: Before: one methane and two oxygen molecules. After: one carbon dioxide and two water molecules.
description: Before: CH₄ and two O₂, holding 1 carbon, 4 hydrogen and 4 oxygen atoms.
After: CO₂ and two H₂O, again 1 carbon, 4 hydrogen and 4 oxygen atoms.

also.lesson: Conservation of mass and relative formula mass
